modes.implementation: proxy/tcp-sidecar (Rust crate): two smoltcp stacks on a virtual Ethernet pair with Tokio streams and wire-level TcpStats (frame/byte counts, TCP retransmit detection by sequence tracking)

modes.title: Userspace TCP leg (smoltcp) under the native wrapper

modes.implementation: grpc_dc::link_stats::LinkStats (Rust) with SctpStats/TcpStats/H2Stats legs; DcEndpoint.linkStats (JS) and DcEndpoint.LinkStats (Go) mirror the shape
modes.note: One snapshot for packet-loss instrumentation on any wrapper path: SCTP counters from the DataChannel leg, TCP counters from the smoltcp sidecar (or kernel leg where available), HTTP/2 frame/stream counters in Rust, Go, and JS
modes.title: Unified LinkStats across SCTP, TCP, and HTTP/2 legs
